title: The first visit's download measured again, and its budget re-argued
items: A first visit to 1835 now downloads 39.98 MB, 0.61 MB more than five days ago: the fort's and the Lake House's hand-made brick, the people's new faces and builds, and the town's walks and yards.
Nothing in it was a careless addition, so the budget moves to 40.2 MB with the reasoning written down, rather than trimming what the town looks like.
